title: The subcategory of pro-etale complexes with an etale origin
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and let $\Lambda$ be a finite discrete commutative ring, for instance one of the finite coefficient rings $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Write $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ for the derived category of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small pro-etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and $D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ for its full subcategory of complexes whose cohomology sheaves vanish below some integer [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] (for a finite discrete $\Lambda$ the coefficient sheaf $U\mapsto\operatorname{Cont}(\pi_0(|U|),\Lambda)$ of that node is the sheafification of the constant presheaf $\Lambda$, so the two nodes describe the same category). Write $D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ for the bounded-below derived category of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and $
u_T^*:D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)	o D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ for the inverse image along the comparison morphism of sites $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], applied degreewise since $
u_T^*$ is exact on sheaves. The category $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(T,\Lambda)$ of *complexes coming from the etale site* has as objects the triples $(K,L,\alpha)$ with $K\in D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, $L\in D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ and $\alpha:
u_T^*L\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ an isomorphism in $D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, that is, an etale-origin witness $(L,\alpha)$ for $K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]; a morphism $(K,L,\alpha)	o(K',L',\alpha')$ is a morphism $K	o K'$ in $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, with the composition of $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$. The forgetful functor $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(T,\Lambda)	o D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, $(K,L,\alpha)\mapsto K$, is fully faithful, and its essential image is the class of objects admitting an etale-origin witness; through it $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(T,\Lambda)$ is regarded as a full subcategory of $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, and a functor defined on $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ is restricted to $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(T,\Lambda)$ by precomposition with the forgetful functor. The witness $(L,\alpha)$, and not only its existence, is part of the object and is carried along whenever a construction transports it.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Proetale.lean: proetaleTopology (big site, line 66), Scheme.ProEt S (schemes weakly etale over S, line 101) and ProEt.topology S (small pro-etale site, line 156), with etaleTopology_le_proetaleTopology (line 79); Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Etale.lean: smallEtaleTopology X (line 51); Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/ElladicCohomology.lean: ellAdicSheaf and EllAdicCohomology (sheaf cohomology of Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab). No functor between the small etale and small pro-etale sites of a scheme, and no comparison of their derived categories, is defined.
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: Mathlib has the small pro-etale site and the small etale site, but not the comparison morphism nu_T between them, nor derived categories of sheaves of modules on them, nor the notion of a complex coming from the etale site

mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: the general ingredients (DerivedCategory of a Grothendieck abelian category, TStructure.plus, ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory) exist, but the notion defined here, the full subcategory of D^+(T_proet, Lambda) of objects with a witness nu^* L = K, has no Mathlib counterpart
